title: setDepletionDuration(1) is a one-tx rug surface: owner can collapse the depletion window so the next _updatePool drains rewardBalance to a single coordinated staker

knownIssueCheck.rationale: Strictly worse than DEDUP-006 because it has no gate at all (no two-step). The bug is the absence of a minimum-duration floor / gate, not the owner's role. Concrete one-tx flash drain. Extra scrutiny applied per High-severity caution rule; finding survives.
